block1.name: Perrin Oake
block1.one_line: a stranded fellow courier with a bent route pin
block1.story_role: A fellow courier who proves the road accidents are a pattern, not bad luck.
block1.game_role: A friendly source and a second opinion; he confirms what the party is starting to suspect.
block1.critical_info: He has walked these roads for years and swears this kind of trouble is new, and made on purpose.
block1.disposition_default: Rattled but steady, relieved to find people who will actually listen.
block1.the_lever: Someone who takes his warning seriously instead of logging it as a delay resolved.

block2.wants_now: Get home alive and make someone believe the accidents are not normal.
block2.larger_motivation: Keep courier work from becoming a polite way to feed people into the road.
block2.wants: Get home alive and make someone believe the accidents are not normal.
block2.motivation: Keep courier work from becoming a polite way to feed people into the road.
block2.personality: Road-worn and warm, humming when he feels safe and silent when he does not. Taps a cracked compass that points to the last place he felt safe instead of north, and pretends that is a feature.
voice: I know what a normal bad road looks like. This is not that.
block2.secrets: He is more scared than his jokes allow.
block2.fears: Dying in a ditch and being logged as delay resolved.

likes_dislikes.likes: Shared trade jokes, hot tea, repaired wheels, and people who respect a good route knot.
likes_dislikes.dislikes: Company reassurance, bad compasses, and being called lucky after losing friends.

block2.likes: Shared trade jokes, hot tea, repaired wheels, and people who respect a good route knot.
block2.dislikes: Company reassurance, bad compasses, and being called lucky after losing friends.
block2.favorite_thing: The cracked dial-compass he still taps even when he no longer trusts it.
block2.loved_ones: A household that knows his route songs and worries when he stops humming.
block2.day_to_day: Walks road miles, swaps warnings with other couriers, and repairs straps by lantern light.

block2.wealth_status: Working poor with expensive tools paid off one dangerous run at a time.
block2.animal_companion: No animal; talks to his overloaded pack as if it has opinions.
block2.physical: A broad simiah courier grins through road dust, wrapped in a battered coat, tapping a cracked compass while coin charms and route tags hang from the straps.

block1.name: Wicket
block1.one_line: a Hexmart pocket-ward vendor with too many charm strings
block1.story_role: The cheerful face of a protection racket that does not know it is one.
block1.game_role: Comedy, a useful trinket, and a quiet seed of how cheap wards fail the people who trust them.
block1.critical_info: The wards he is selling fail most often in exactly the places people stake their lives on them.
block1.disposition_default: Delighted to see a customer, quietly terrified you will ask the charms to actually work.
block1.the_lever: Let him finish the sales flourish before you doubt him, and he tells you more than he means to.

block2.wants_now: Make a sale and prove the charms are not a scam.
block2.larger_motivation: Stay ahead of debt by believing the pitch harder than anyone else.
block2.wants: Make a sale and prove the charms are not a scam.
block2.motivation: Stay ahead of debt by believing the pitch harder than anyone else.
block2.personality: All flourish and warmth on top, frantic arithmetic underneath. Compliments you, then names the price, then the problem, in that order, every time. He believes the pitch because the alternative is unbearable.
voice: It worked this morning. Mostly. That counts as inspected.
block2.secrets: The wards have been failing more often than he admits.
block2.fears: Refunds, ridicule, and the day he has to tell his creditors the tray is worthless.

block2.dislikes: Careful testing, quiet pity, and anyone saying protection racket within earshot.

block1.name: Nettle
block1.one_line: a frightened forest scout trying not to be seen
block1.story_role: A frightened Bramble scout who shows the camp is people, not bandits.

block1.disposition_default: Cornered and trembling, desperate not to prove their own fears right.

block2.wants_now: Get back to camp without proving mercy is foolish.

block2.wants: Get back to camp without proving mercy is foolish.
block2.motivation: Keep their people alive without learning to hate everyone outside the trees.

block2.secrets: Nettle can name who did not want the ambush to go violent.
block2.fears: Being handed to officials, disappointing Kett, and watching the camp starve anyway.

block1.name: Auditor Holle
block1.one_line: a collections agent with a smile that never reaches the ledger
block1.story_role: The polite face of debt, proving that cruelty wears clean gloves.
block1.game_role: A social antagonist who cannot be punched into leaving; she must be out-argued or outlasted.
block1.critical_info: She believes perfect procedure absolves her, and a debtor who reminds her of her own old mercy can crack that belief.
block1.the_lever: A moment that forces her to see the person standing where the balance should be.

block2.wants_now: Make the account balance without letting the human cost enter the room.
block2.larger_motivation: Prove that perfect process can protect her from moral responsibility.
block2.wants: Make the account balance without letting the human cost enter the room.
block2.motivation: Prove that perfect process can protect her from moral responsibility.
block2.personality: Immaculate calm built as a wall against her own memory of once needing mercy. Polishes a closed-eye page weight before she speaks. Insists cruelty is merely inefficient, which is its own quiet kind of confession.
voice: I am not here for cruelty. Cruelty is inefficient.
block2.secrets: She knows escalation can become worse than collection, and she keeps choosing not to picture it.
block2.fears: A debtor who makes her remember she once needed mercy.

likes_dislikes.likes: Exact figures, sealed receipts, soft voices, and procedural victories.

block2.dislikes: Tears, improvisation, unpaid kindness, and forged stamps that work too well.

block2.day_to_day: Rises early, reviews balances, practices condolences, and travels with clean boots through dirty places.

block1.name: Mama Suet
block1.one_line: a Firstmoss forager carrying food and practical comfort
block1.story_role: The grandmother of the road, who feeds first and judges never.
block1.game_role: A comfort and a compass; she steadies frightened players and points them true.
block1.critical_info: She remembers the forest before the toll signs, and she will tell you, if you eat first.
block1.disposition_default: Unhurried and nurturing, quietly unimpressed by uniforms.
block1.the_lever: Sit down and accept the soup; she opens to anyone who lets themselves be cared for.

block2.wants_now: Get frightened people warm enough to make better choices.
block2.larger_motivation: Keep the old forest memory alive through care, food, and stubborn patience.
block2.wants: Get frightened people warm enough to make better choices.
block2.motivation: Keep the old forest memory alive through care, food, and stubborn patience.
block2.personality: Stubborn tenderness in a worn shell. Carries a spoon worn thin by decades of feeding people, and a scarf from a child she fed in a failed harvest, to remind herself that care should travel. Fears the young accepting danger as the ordinary price of being noticed.
voice: Eat first. Then decide what kind of brave you are being.
block2.secrets: She remembers who came first with ledgers and who pretended the danger was natural.
block2.fears: Young people accepting danger as the normal price of being noticed.

likes_dislikes.likes: Patience, washed hands, honest hunger, and someone taking seconds without apology.
likes_dislikes.dislikes: Rushing elders, wasting food, and calling old memory superstition.

block2.dislikes: Rushing elders, wasting food, and calling old memory superstition.
block2.favorite_thing: A smooth wooden spoon worn thin by decades of feeding people.
block2.loved_ones: The young ones of Hush, which in her mind means nearly everyone.
block2.day_to_day: Gathers moss at first light, checks on sick neighbors, simmers soup, and remembers the forest before toll signs.

block2.fears: Forgetting the last face and becoming only a useful skeleton.

abilities: Defeat rule: 6 or less damage marks 1 HP; more than 6 defeats it.
